headline: Anthropic opened a Singapore office and signed a safety MOU with MDDI
body: Anthropic has opened an office in Singapore, its fifth in APAC, and signed a MoU with the Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI). The MOU covers AI safety, security and model evaluation, and Anthropic plans technical exchanges with Singapore's AI safety institutions.

evidence.text: Anthropic has opened an office in Singapore, its fifth in APAC, and signed a MoU with the Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI).
The MOU covers AI safety, security, model evaluation, research into AI adoption and its impact, and responsible deployment across the public and private sectors.
Anthropic plans to hold technical exchanges with Singapore’s AI safety institutions on model evaluation, testing standards and incident response.
